# Avani Enterprises

> Avani Enterprises is a leading web development, software, and digital marketing agency headquartered in Gurugram (DLF Cyber City), Haryana, India. The company builds high-performance websites, custom business software (CRM, HR portals, business operating systems), AI automation, and runs high-ROI SEO, Google Ads, Meta Ads, and social media campaigns for businesses across North India and major Indian cities.

## Key facts

- Name: Avani Enterprises
- Headquarters: DLF Cyber City, Gurugram, Haryana 122002, India
- Founded: 2016 (8+ years of experience)
- Track record: 150+ clients, 300+ projects delivered
- Phone: +91 92536 25099
- Email: kp@avanienterprises.in
- Primary service regions: Haryana, Delhi NCR (Gurgaon, Noida, Greater Noida, Ghaziabad, Faridabad), Rohtak, Panipat, Karnal, Sonipat, Hisar, Ambala, Chandigarh, plus Mumbai, Pune, and pan-India.
